Notes: Suspended 22 Jan to 16 Mar 2026 (Rodalies rail crisis), normal since 16 Mar 2026. Supreme Court annulled the original ordinance (2023); replacement ordinance approved Jan 2023. 2025 stage (diesel Euro 5, petrol Euro 2 barred) had been postponed to 2027 by ordinance of 21 Mar 2025; Constitutional Court annulled that postponement (judgment 174/2025, 11 Dec 2025), so it applied from 1 Jan 2026 with warning letters; fines issued from 1 Jul 2026. Government plans an annual pass or EUR 80 monthly cap (legal framework not yet published, Ayvens Oct 2026). Next stage (diesel Euro 6, petrol Euro 3) due 2028 per Brussels Times (Mar 2026).
